label: Muse Code Access
description: A Meta Model API login, for the MuseCode nodes' `access`: an API key, billed pay as you go. One access for however many MuseCode nodes. A Muse Code subscription is not offered here: its credential is for use with Muse Code only, and the shape of its login file is undocumented; on your machine, leaving `access` out uses your own `muse login`.

steps: Log in to the Model API dashboard and open the API keys tab.
Create a key and copy it right away (it is shown once).
Paste it below and name the connection. Calls are billed pay as you go.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into the MuseCode nodes' `access` input.
